description: Ideas of scientists from earlier centuries (so far: Renaissance and the age of discovery 1350-1600, and the 19th century) chosen by one test: does the idea give an AI agent a rule today? Each card has the idea, the rule, the agent blind spot and a 'bridge' naming the Crystal Library cards or live Orb Studio sensors it works with (for example Lorenzo Valla, who exposed a forgery by anachronistic words, and today's date-checking of sources). Filter by era, blind_spot or query.
name: get_time_machine
title: Time Machine: rules for AI agents from scientists of any era, with bridges across the centuries
